newsitem.title: USA: ComEd to hike power at Ill. Quad Cities 2.
newsitem.headline: ComEd to hike power at Ill. Quad Cities 2.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co (ComEd) said Tuesday it will begin increasing power output from its 789 megawatt (MW) Quad Cities 2 nuclear generating unit later today.
Production at Cordova, Ill., unit was reduced to 200 MW during repairs of a packing leak on a containment valve used in the unit's reactor water cleanup system.
"Repairs have been completed. We're ready to increase load this afternoon," a company spokesman said.
The Nuclear Regulatory Commission in today's daily status report said testing at Quad Cities 2 was in progress to determine either ascension or unit shutdown for repairs.
Quad Cities 2 could resume full output Wednesday, he added. "It typically takes a day to reach full power."
Commonwealth Edison is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
